summary: tracim is a collaborative team workspace platform (Python/Pyramid/SQLAlchemy) persisting users, workspaces, contents with immutable revision history, workspace roles/members, tags, reactions, comments, share/upload-permission links, favorites, subscriptions, event/message queues and user-call records; REST API over sqlalchemy + alembic migrations

_no_edges.why: session teardown action; clears session via forget() and closes live-message channels (session_controller.py:70), no persisted business state, no guard and no downstream op edge

public self-registration endpoint POST /users/register (user_controller.py:526); config-gated (USER__SELF_REGISTRATION__ENABLED) but no auth decorator (works for anonymous users); creates the user directly
internal shared helper (lib/core/user.py:1087, entry internal); guards live on each HTTP-calling endpoint that invokes it; not independently reachable over the wire
public endpoint POST /auth/password/reset/request (reset_password_controller.py:36); no auth (must work for logged-out users); swallows errors to avoid user enumeration
public endpoint POST /auth/password/reset/modify (reset_password_controller.py:90); no auth; gated only by the emailed reset token

public login POST /auth/login (session_controller.py:98); no auth decorator (must work for logged-out users); performs credential check against User and issues session - no downstream op edge and no auth wall
